## gtm.help (Remote)

The official hosted MCP server for gtm.help, an AI GTM engineer that reads a website and writes a ranked growth plan of plays. It lets AI assistants read a user's workspaces, business profile and ranked growth plays, update play status, save finished drafts for a play, mark plays shipped, add notes about the business, share a progress recap, and work with the Reddit, LinkedIn and X conversations the gtm.help agents find (list, draft a reply, record the outcome, edit watch lists). `analyze_site` returns three growth plays for any website.

**Account.** Requires a gtm.help account (7-day free trial, then $97/month).

**Authorization.** OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. The tool list is public; calling a tool needs sign-in.

**Data-changing tools.** `update_play_status`, `submit_play_draft`, `complete_play`, `add_business_note`, `share_recap` (creates a public share URL), `draft_reply`, `update_opportunity` and `update_watchlist` change data inside gtm.help only. Nothing is posted to Reddit, LinkedIn or X on the user's behalf.

Docs: https://gtm.help/for-agents
